upstream.description: Engineering decisions engine that know when they're stale. Frame, compare, decide — with evidence decay and parity enforcement. For Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex and more.

classification.analysis: Haft (repo cloned as quint-code) is a local governance and project-memory layer for AI coding agents, built on the First Principles Framework: it tracks the problem being solved, compared options, human decisions, supporting evidence, and evidence staleness as typed, versioned records rather than lost conversation context. It targets developers using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and similar agents who want durable, auditable engineering decisions with staleness/drift detection, delivered as a Go CLI/MCP server (`haft`) with per-host skill and instruction-file integration and a local SQLite-backed decision ledger.

use_cases.title: Record and enforce engineering decisions across an AI coding agent's sessions
Detect when a past architectural decision has gone stale
Wire a durable MCP memory/governance layer into Claude Code or Codex
